ex.en: I met her on campus yesterday.
ex.zh: 我昨天在校園裡遇到她。

ex.en: She showed me around the campus.
ex.zh: 她帶我參觀了校園。

ex.en: We met in a coffee shop near the campus.
ex.zh: 我們在學校附近的咖啡店碰面。

campus.en: the land and buildings of a school or university

ex.en: This instrument needs to be calibrated.
ex.zh: 這台儀器需要校準。

ex.en: Calibrate the scale before you weigh the samples.
ex.zh: 秤樣本之前先校準磅秤。

calibrate.en: to adjust a tool so that it gives correct measurements

ex.en: Taking the train instead of flying reduces your carbon footprint.
ex.zh: 搭火車而不搭飛機可以減少碳足跡。

ex.en: The company wants to cut its carbon footprint in half.
ex.zh: 這家公司想把碳足跡減半。

carbon footprint.en: the amount of harmful gas that a person or activity produces

ex.en: The telephone operator asked the caller to hold on until a connection was made.
ex.zh: 接線生請來電者稍候，等待接通。

ex.en: The caller didn't leave a message.
ex.zh: 來電的人沒有留言。

ex.en: We received dozens of callers asking about the sale.
ex.zh: 我們接到好幾十通來電詢問特賣活動。

caller.en: a person who rings someone by phone

ex.en: You have a caller waiting at the front desk.
ex.zh: 有一位訪客在櫃檯等你。

ex.en: We don't get many callers on Sundays.
ex.zh: 星期天我們這裡不太有訪客。

caller.en: a person who comes to visit someone

cafeteria.zh: 自助餐廳；（公司、學校的）員工餐廳

ex.en: The food in the cafeteria is cheap, and it's delicious.
ex.zh: 餐廳的餐點很便宜，而且很好吃。

ex.en: He eats lunch at a cafeteria.
ex.zh: 他在自助餐廳吃午餐。

ex.en: I'd like to work at the cafeteria.
ex.zh: 我想在餐廳工作。

cafeteria.en: a restaurant where you serve yourself, often at a school or workplace

ex.en: I had a cup of coffee at the cafe.
ex.zh: 我在咖啡館喝了一杯咖啡。

ex.en: I drink coffee in a cafe.
ex.zh: 我在咖啡館喝咖啡。

ex.en: Is there a cafe?
ex.zh: 這裡有咖啡館嗎？

cafe.en: a small place where you can buy drinks and light meals

ex.en: She hung the calendar on the wall.
ex.zh: 她把月曆掛在牆上。

ex.en: In the Spanish calendar, the week begins with Monday.
ex.zh: 在西班牙的日曆上，一週從星期一開始。

ex.en: In China, they celebrate New Year by the lunar calendar.
ex.zh: 在中國，人們依農曆過新年。

calendar.en: a chart showing the days, weeks and months of a year

ex.en: Let me check my calendar before I say yes.
ex.zh: 答應之前讓我先看一下我的行事曆。

ex.en: I'll send you a calendar invite for Friday's meeting.
ex.zh: 我會寄給你星期五會議的行事曆邀請。

calendar.en: a list of plans and events arranged by date

ex.en: Please replace the empty ink cartridge in the printer.
ex.zh: 請把印表機裡沒墨水的墨水匣換掉。

ex.en: We need to order more toner cartridges.
ex.zh: 我們需要再訂一些碳粉匣。

ex.en: This printer cartridge costs almost as much as the printer.
ex.zh: 這個印表機墨水匣幾乎跟印表機一樣貴。

cartridge.en: a small container that is put into a machine and holds ink or powder

ex.en: Jessie strolled along beside the cart.
ex.zh: 傑西在推車旁邊慢慢走著。

ex.en: I put the milk in the shopping cart.
ex.zh: 我把牛奶放進購物車。

ex.en: Click here to add the item to your cart.
ex.zh: 點這裡把商品加入購物車。

cart.en: a small vehicle with wheels that you push to carry things

ex.en: A horse pulled the cart along the road.
ex.zh: 一匹馬沿著路拉著貨車。

ex.en: I saw a horse pulling a cart.
ex.zh: 我看到一匹馬在拉車。

cart.en: an open vehicle with two or four wheels pulled by an animal

ex.en: The captain is responsible for the safety of passengers.
ex.zh: 船長要負責乘客的安全。

ex.en: Captains have responsibility for ship and crew.
ex.zh: 船長要對船隻和船員負責。

ex.en: This is your captain speaking. We will land shortly.
ex.zh: 這裡是機長廣播，我們即將降落。

captain.en: the person in charge of a ship or plane

ex.en: Tom is the captain of this baseball team.
ex.zh: 湯姆是這支棒球隊的隊長。

ex.en: We want you to be the team captain.
ex.zh: 我們希望你當隊長。

ex.en: George is the captain of our team.
ex.zh: 喬治是我們隊的隊長。

captain.en: the leader of a sports team

ex.en: The calculator on the table is mine.
ex.zh: 桌上那台計算機是我的。

ex.en: The batteries in my calculator are dead.
ex.zh: 我計算機的電池沒電了。

ex.en: You may use a calculator during the exam.
ex.zh: 考試時可以使用計算機。

calculator.en: a small electronic device used for doing sums

ex.en: I took a cab to the station.
ex.zh: 我搭了計程車到車站。

ex.en: I left my umbrella in the cab.
ex.zh: 我把我的傘忘在計程車上了。

ex.en: He called a cab for me.
ex.zh: 他幫我叫了一輛計程車。

cab.en: a car with a driver that you pay to take you somewhere

ex.en: The writer is living in a log cabin.
ex.zh: 那位作家住在一間小木屋裡。

ex.en: He built a cabin on the beach.
ex.zh: 他在海灘上蓋了一間小屋。

cabin.en: a small simple house made of wood

ex.en: The cabin crew will serve drinks shortly.
ex.zh: 空服員稍後將提供飲料。

ex.en: Our cabin on the ship had a small window.
ex.zh: 我們在船上的艙房有一扇小窗。

cabin.en: a room or space on a ship or plane

ex.en: We can wear casual clothes on Fridays.
ex.zh: 我們星期五可以穿便服。

ex.en: The restaurant has a casual atmosphere.
ex.zh: 這家餐廳氣氛很輕鬆。

ex.en: He made a casual remark about the budget.
ex.zh: 他隨口提到了預算的事。

ex.en: It was just a casual conversation.
ex.zh: 那只是隨意聊聊而已。

casual.en: done without much thought or planning

ex.en: The factory hires casual workers in summer.
ex.zh: 工廠夏天會僱用臨時工。

ex.en: She has a casual job at a café.
ex.zh: 她在咖啡店打零工。

ex.en: There is a fee for late cancellations.
ex.zh: 太晚取消要收手續費。

ex.en: We had a cancellation, so a room is now available.
ex.zh: 有人取消訂房，所以現在有空房了。

cancellation.en: a decision that something planned will not happen

ex.en: The carpenter brought his tools along.
ex.zh: 木匠把工具帶來了。

ex.en: My grandfather is a carpenter.
ex.zh: 我爺爺是個木匠。

ex.en: He is a good carpenter.
ex.zh: 他是個好木匠。

carpenter.en: a person whose job is making things out of wood

ex.en: We hired a caterer for the company party.
ex.zh: 我們請了外燴業者負責公司派對。

ex.en: The caterer will arrive two hours before the event.
ex.zh: 外燴業者會在活動前兩小時抵達。

caterer.en: a person or company that provides food for events

ex.en: The calculation of the budget for next year is based on the costs this year.
ex.zh: 明年的預算是根據今年的成本計算的。

ex.en: According to my calculation, she should be in India by now.
ex.zh: 依我的推算，她現在應該已經到印度了。

ex.en: There was an error in the calculation.
ex.zh: 計算過程中有一個錯誤。

calculation.en: the act of working out a number, or the result of it

ex.en: Please use caution when driving in the rain.
ex.zh: 雨天開車請小心。

ex.en: Handle this box with caution.
ex.zh: 搬這個箱子要小心。

caution.en: great care to avoid danger or mistakes

ex.en: Caution! Wet floor.
ex.zh: 小心地滑！

ex.en: Caution! Wet Paint
ex.zh: 注意！油漆未乾。

ex.en: The doctor cautioned me against eating too much salt.
ex.zh: 醫生告誡我不要吃太鹹。

ex.en: Experts caution that prices may rise again.
ex.zh: 專家警告物價可能再次上漲。

caution.en: to warn someone about possible danger or problems

ex.en: My son took a candy from the box.
ex.zh: 我兒子從盒子裡拿了一顆糖。

ex.en: Divide the candies among you.
ex.zh: 你們把這些糖果分一分吧。

ex.en: I never should've let Tom eat so much candy.
ex.zh: 我真不該讓湯姆吃那麼多糖果。

candy.en: a small sweet food, often made of sugar

ex.en: I bought a carton of milk.
ex.zh: 我買了一盒牛奶。

ex.en: The products are packed in cartons of 12.
ex.zh: 產品以每箱十二個包裝。

ex.en: Please recycle the empty cartons.
ex.zh: 請回收空紙箱。

carton.en: a container made of thin cardboard or plastic

ex.en: It was careless of you to leave the door unlocked.
ex.zh: 你沒鎖門，真是太不小心了。

ex.en: It is careless of her to make such a mistake.
ex.zh: 她會犯這種錯，真是太粗心了。

ex.en: A careless person is apt to make mistakes.
ex.zh: 粗心的人容易犯錯。

careless.en: not giving enough attention to avoid mistakes

ex.en: She's very cautious.
ex.zh: 她很謹慎。

ex.en: You must be cautious.
ex.zh: 你一定要小心。

ex.en: Investors are cautious about the market.
ex.zh: 投資人對市場態度謹慎。

cautious.en: careful to avoid danger or problems

ex.en: The girl released the birds from the cage.
ex.zh: 女孩把鳥從籠子裡放了出來。

ex.en: The tiger laid in the middle of the cage.
ex.zh: 老虎躺在籠子中間。

ex.en: She set the bird free from the cage.
ex.zh: 她把小鳥從籠子裡放走了。

cage.en: a space closed in with bars or wire for keeping animals

ex.en: Capitalism encourages competition among businesses.
ex.zh: 資本主義鼓勵企業之間互相競爭。

ex.en: The professor gave a lecture on the history of capitalism.
ex.zh: 教授講了一堂關於資本主義歷史的課。

capitalism.en: an economic system in which businesses are owned by private people

ex.en: The company's market capitalization exceeds ten billion dollars.
ex.zh: 這家公司的市值超過一百億美元。

ex.en: Market capitalization is the share price times the number of shares.
ex.zh: 市值就是股價乘以股數。

capitalization.en: the total value of a company's shares

ex.en: Check the spelling and capitalization before you submit.
ex.zh: 交出去之前檢查一下拼字和大小寫。

ex.en: Capitalization rules are different in German.
ex.zh: 德文的大寫規則不一樣。

capitalization.en: the use of big letters at the start of words

capitalist.zh: 資本家；投資者（venture capitalist 創投業者）

ex.en: The startup is looking for a venture capitalist.
ex.zh: 那家新創公司正在找創投業者。

ex.en: Early capitalists built factories across the country.
ex.zh: 早期的資本家在全國各地建了工廠。

capitalist.en: a person who invests money in businesses to make a profit

ex.en: Russia wasn't capitalist.
ex.zh: 俄羅斯當時並不是資本主義國家。

ex.en: The country has a capitalist economy.
ex.zh: 這個國家實行資本主義經濟。

capitalist.en: based on a system where businesses are owned privately and run for profit

ex.en: I didn't mean to capitalize this.
ex.zh: 我不是故意要用大寫的。

ex.en: Do not forget to capitalize.
ex.zh: 別忘了用大寫。

capitalize.en: to write a letter or word with a big first letter

capitalize.zh: capitalize on：利用（機會）、趁勢獲利

ex.en: We should capitalize on this opportunity.
ex.zh: 我們應該好好利用這個機會。

ex.en: The company capitalized on the growing demand for electric cars.
ex.zh: 這家公司抓住了電動車需求成長的商機。

capitalize.en: to use a situation to get an advantage or profit

ex.en: Toyota is one of the world's largest carmakers.
ex.zh: 豐田是全球最大的汽車製造商之一。

ex.en: The carmaker recalled thousands of vehicles.
ex.zh: 這家車廠召回了數千輛汽車。

ex.en: The oil cartel agreed to cut production.
ex.zh: 石油卡特爾同意減產。

ex.en: The companies were fined for forming a price cartel.
ex.zh: 這些公司因聯合壟斷價格而被罰款。

cartel.en: a group of companies that agree together to control prices and limit competition

ex.en: There were no casualties in the fire.
ex.zh: 這場火災沒有人傷亡。

ex.en: The accident caused several casualties.
ex.zh: 這起事故造成數人傷亡。

casualty.en: a person who is hurt or killed in an accident or war

ex.en: Small businesses were the first casualties of the recession.
ex.zh: 小型企業是經濟衰退最先受害的對象。

ex.en: Quality became a casualty of the rush to finish.
ex.zh: 為了趕工，品質成了犧牲品。

casualty.en: a person or thing that suffers badly because of an event or situation

ex.en: The hotel has a casino on the first floor.
ex.zh: 這家飯店一樓有賭場。

ex.en: He lost a lot of money at the casino.
ex.zh: 他在賭場輸了很多錢。

casino.en: a place where people play games to win money

ex.en: Their cattle are all fat.
ex.zh: 他們的牛都很肥。

ex.en: Look after the cattle.
ex.zh: 把那些牛照顧好。

cattle.en: cows and bulls kept on a farm for meat or milk

ex.en: The oil spill was an environmental catastrophe.
ex.zh: 那次漏油事件是一場環境浩劫。

ex.en: Losing the files would be a catastrophe for the project.
ex.zh: 遺失那些檔案對專案來說會是一場災難。

catastrophe.en: a sudden event that causes great damage or suffering

ex.en: You could count to ten when you were two.
ex.zh: 你兩歲時就能數到十了。

ex.en: Can you speak Japanese?
ex.zh: 你會說日文嗎？

can.en: used to say that someone has the ability or skill to do something

ex.en: Can I use your phone?
ex.zh: 我可以用你的手機嗎？

ex.en: You can leave early today.
ex.zh: 你今天可以早點下班。

can.en: used to ask for or give permission to do something

ex.en: It can't be true!
ex.zh: 那不可能是真的！

ex.en: Mornings can be very cold here.
ex.zh: 這裡早上有時會很冷。

can.en: used to say something is possible, or when negative, that it is very unlikely

ex.en: I bought a can of soda.
ex.zh: 我買了一罐汽水。

ex.en: Please recycle your empty cans.
ex.zh: 請回收空罐。

can.en: a closed metal container for food or drink

ex.en: Cottage cheese and canned peaches are a delicious combination.
ex.zh: 茅屋起司配桃子罐頭是很美味的組合。

ex.en: Tom got mercury poisoning from eating canned tuna every day.
ex.zh: 湯姆每天吃鮪魚罐頭，結果汞中毒了。

can.en: to put food or drink into a metal container to keep it fresh

ex.en: This rule does not apply in all cases.
ex.zh: 這條規則並非適用於所有情況。

ex.en: We can find similar situations in these next few cases.
ex.zh: 在接下來這幾個例子中，我們也能看到類似的情況。

ex.en: In that case, let's meet tomorrow.
ex.zh: 那樣的話，我們明天見吧。

case.en: an example of a situation or thing happening

ex.en: He intended to reexamine the case from the beginning.
ex.zh: 他打算從頭重新調查這個案件。

ex.en: It is difficult for me to handle the case.
ex.zh: 這個案子我很難處理。

case.en: a matter that police or a court deals with, or a person with an illness

ex.en: In case of fire, do not use the lift.
ex.zh: 發生火災時，請勿搭乘電梯。

ex.en: Take an umbrella in case it rains.
ex.zh: 帶把傘以防下雨。

case.en: used to talk about something that might happen, so you are ready for it

ex.en: I need a new phone case.
ex.zh: 我需要一個新的手機殼。

ex.en: She put her glasses back in the case.
ex.zh: 她把眼鏡放回眼鏡盒。

case.en: a container or cover used to hold or protect something

ex.en: It's time for you to buy a new car.
ex.zh: 你該買一輛新車了。

ex.en: This road is too narrow for cars to pass.
ex.zh: 這條路太窄，車子過不去。

car.en: a road vehicle with four wheels and an engine

ex.en: My physics teacher doesn't care if I skip classes.
ex.zh: 我的物理老師不在乎我是否翹課。

ex.en: I think you're the only one who cares.
ex.zh: 我覺得你是唯一在乎的人。

ex.en: I don't care as long as you are happy.
ex.zh: 只要你開心，我都無所謂。

care.en: to feel that something is important or to be worried about it

ex.en: He cared for his mother after his father died.
ex.zh: 父親過世後，他就照顧母親。

ex.en: No one is caring for this patient.
ex.zh: 沒有人在照顧這位病人。

care.en: to look after someone and give them what they need

ex.en: Handle this package with care.
ex.zh: 這個包裹請小心輕放。

ex.en: Patients here receive excellent care.
ex.zh: 這裡的病人受到很好的照顧。

care.en: the act of looking after someone, or attention to avoid mistakes or danger

ex.en: The committee inquired into the cause of the accident.
ex.zh: 委員會調查了事故的原因。

ex.en: Research on the causes of cancer is very expensive.
ex.zh: 癌症成因的研究非常昂貴。

cause.en: a person or thing that makes something happen

ex.en: The explosion may have been caused by a gas leak.
ex.zh: 這起爆炸可能是瓦斯外洩引起的。

ex.en: The Taiwanese dollar appreciated, causing Taiwanese exports to slump.
ex.zh: 新台幣升值，造成台灣出口大幅下滑。

ex.en: Sorry for causing so much trouble.
ex.zh: 抱歉造成這麼多麻煩。

cause.en: to make something happen, usually something bad

ex.en: Tom always carries a camera with him wherever he goes.
ex.zh: 湯姆不管去哪裡都帶著相機。

ex.en: The young woman was carrying an infant in her arms.
ex.zh: 那位年輕女子懷裡抱著嬰兒。

ex.en: This machine is too heavy for me to carry.
ex.zh: 這台機器太重了，我搬不動。

carry.en: to hold something and take it from one place to another

ex.en: This plan will be very expensive to carry out.
ex.zh: 這個計畫執行起來會非常昂貴。

ex.en: We will carry out a customer survey next month.
ex.zh: 我們下個月將進行顧客調查。

carry.en: to do something that has been planned or ordered

ex.en: We carried on the discussion till late at night.
ex.zh: 我們一直討論到深夜。

ex.en: Please carry on with your work.
ex.zh: 請繼續你的工作。

carry.en: to keep doing something without stopping

ex.en: Do you carry this shirt in a larger size?
ex.zh: 這件襯衫有賣大一點的尺寸嗎？

ex.en: The store carries many local brands.
ex.zh: 這家店有賣很多本土品牌。

carry.en: to have goods available for customers to buy

ex.en: You will not be able to catch the train.
ex.zh: 你會趕不上火車。

ex.en: I have to catch the eight o'clock bus.
ex.zh: 我得趕上八點的公車。

catch.en: to get on a bus, train or plane in time

ex.en: We all caught flu, and so did the teacher.
ex.zh: 我們全都得了流感，連老師也是。

ex.en: I caught a cold and was in bed yesterday.
ex.zh: 我感冒了，昨天躺在床上休息。

catch.en: to get an illness from someone or something

ex.en: Tom caught the ball with one hand.
ex.zh: 湯姆單手接住了球。

ex.en: The police caught the thief last night.
ex.zh: 警察昨晚抓到了小偷。

catch.en: to take hold of something moving, or to stop and take a person or animal

ex.en: Sorry, I didn't catch your name.
ex.zh: 抱歉，我沒聽清楚你的名字。

ex.en: I didn't catch what he said.
ex.zh: 我沒聽清楚他說什麼。

catch.en: to hear or understand something that someone says

ex.en: If you hurry, you will catch up with him.
ex.zh: 如果你快一點，還能追上他。

ex.en: We have lots of catching up to do.
ex.zh: 我們有好多近況要聊。

catch.en: to reach someone ahead of you, or to talk after a long time apart

ex.en: How many Christmas cards did you write last year?
ex.zh: 你去年寫了幾張聖誕卡？

ex.en: At Christmas we send Christmas cards to our friends.
ex.zh: 聖誕節時我們寄聖誕卡給朋友。

card.en: a piece of stiff paper with a picture or message, sent on special days

ex.en: I would like to pay with a credit card.
ex.zh: 我想用信用卡付款。

ex.en: My ID card has expired, what should I do?
ex.zh: 我的身分證過期了，該怎麼辦？

ex.en: I usually use a credit card instead of cash.
ex.zh: 我通常用信用卡，而不是現金。

card.en: a small plastic piece used to pay for things or show who you are

ex.en: Place the deck of cards on the oaken table.
ex.zh: 把那副撲克牌放在橡木桌上。

ex.en: Let's play cards after dinner.
ex.zh: 晚餐後來玩牌吧。

card.en: one of a set of small papers with numbers and pictures used for games

ex.en: Tom and Mary went camping in the mountains.
ex.zh: 湯姆和瑪麗去山上露營。

ex.en: Tom doesn't have any friends who like camping.
ex.zh: 湯姆沒有喜歡露營的朋友。

ex.en: We camped by the lake last weekend.
ex.zh: 我們上週末在湖邊露營。

camp.en: to stay outdoors in a tent for a short time

ex.en: The blizzard made it difficult for us to return to the camp.
ex.zh: 暴風雪讓我們很難回到營地。

ex.en: A small rock was thrown into our camp.
ex.zh: 有顆小石頭被丟進我們的營地。

ex.en: My son is going to summer camp in July.
ex.zh: 我兒子七月要去參加夏令營。

camp.en: a place with tents or simple buildings where people stay for a time

ex.en: He divided his books into five categories.
ex.zh: 他把他的書分成五類。

ex.en: You need to create two new categories.
ex.zh: 你需要建立兩個新分類。

ex.en: Which category does this product belong to?
ex.zh: 這項產品屬於哪個類別？

category.en: a group of things that are alike in some way

ex.en: Research on the causes of cancer is very expensive.
ex.zh: 研究癌症成因的費用非常高。

ex.en: Scientists haven't found a cure for cancer yet.
ex.zh: 科學家還沒找到治療癌症的方法。

ex.en: Tiny particles in the air can cause cancer.
ex.zh: 空氣中的微粒可能會致癌。

cancer.en: a serious disease in which cells in the body grow in a way that is not normal

ex.en: The old man walked across the road carefully.
ex.zh: 老人小心翼翼地過馬路。

ex.en: Compare the two carefully, and you will see the difference.
ex.zh: 仔細比較這兩者，你就會看出差別。

ex.en: When taking drugs, follow the directions on the bottle carefully.
ex.zh: 服藥時要仔細遵照瓶身上的說明。

carefully.en: in a way that pays close attention to avoid mistakes or danger

ex.en: I'm going to buy a camera for my daughter.
ex.zh: 我打算買一台相機給我女兒。

ex.en: Japan produces a lot of good cameras.
ex.zh: 日本生產很多好相機。

ex.en: Your camera is only half the size of mine.
ex.zh: 你的相機只有我的一半大。

camera.en: a piece of equipment used for taking photographs

ex.en: Security cameras are installed in the lobby.
ex.zh: 大廳裝有監視攝影機。

ex.en: Please turn on your camera during the video call.
ex.zh: 視訊通話時請打開你的鏡頭。

camera.en: a device that records moving pictures or watches a place

ex.en: The movie has an amazing cast.
ex.zh: 這部電影的演員陣容很強大。

ex.en: The cast of the play includes several famous actors.
ex.zh: 這齣戲的演員包括幾位知名演員。

cast.en: all the actors in a film, play or show

ex.en: She cast a shy glance on the young man.
ex.zh: 她害羞地看了那個年輕人一眼。

ex.en: Millions of people cast their votes yesterday.
ex.zh: 昨天有數百萬人投下了選票。

cast.en: to direct a look at someone or to give a vote

ex.en: His arm is in a cast after the accident.
ex.zh: 意外後他的手臂打了石膏。

ex.en: She had to wear a cast for six weeks.
ex.zh: 她得打六週的石膏。

cast.en: a hard cover put around a broken bone to hold it in place

ex.en: You cannot be too careful in crossing a street.
ex.zh: 過馬路再怎麼小心都不為過。

ex.en: You must be more careful about spelling and punctuation.
ex.zh: 你在拼字和標點符號上要更仔細。

ex.en: You must be careful not to make him angry.
ex.zh: 你要小心別惹他生氣。

careful.en: paying close attention so that you avoid mistakes or danger

ex.en: The policeman captured the man who was running.
ex.zh: 警察抓到了那個正在逃跑的男人。

ex.en: The hunters captured the wild animal with a strong rope net.
ex.zh: 獵人們用堅固的繩網捉住了那隻野生動物。

capture.en: to catch a person or animal and keep them

capture.zh: 吸引（注意）；捕捉（畫面、氣氛）

ex.en: The ad captured the attention of young consumers.
ex.zh: 這則廣告吸引了年輕消費者的注意。

ex.en: This photo captures the beauty of the city.
ex.zh: 這張照片捕捉到這座城市的美。

capture.en: to get someone's interest, or to show a feeling or moment in a picture or words

ex.en: The company aims to capture 20% of the market.
ex.zh: 公司的目標是拿下兩成的市佔率。

ex.en: Their new phone captured a large share of the market.
ex.zh: 他們的新手機拿下了很大的市場佔有率。

capture.en: to win or gain a share of a market

ex.en: I feed my cat every morning and every evening.
ex.zh: 我每天早晚都餵我的貓。

ex.en: We have two dogs, three cats, and six chickens.
ex.zh: 我們養了兩隻狗、三隻貓和六隻雞。

ex.en: This is the biggest cat that I've ever seen.
ex.zh: 這是我見過最大的貓。

cat.en: a small furry animal that people keep as a pet

ex.en: This airplane is capable of carrying 40 passengers at a time.
ex.zh: 這架飛機一次可載 40 名乘客。

ex.en: Computers are capable of doing extremely complicated work.
ex.zh: 電腦能夠處理極為複雜的工作。

ex.en: The baby is not capable of walking yet.
ex.zh: 這個嬰兒還不會走路。

ex.en: She is a very capable manager.
ex.zh: 她是一位非常能幹的經理。

ex.en: Don't worry, the project is in capable hands.
ex.zh: 別擔心，這個專案交給了能幹的人負責。

capable.en: good at doing things and able to do them well

ex.en: He calculated the expenses.
ex.zh: 他計算了費用。

ex.en: Scientists can easily calculate the distances between planets.
ex.zh: 科學家可以輕易算出行星之間的距離。

ex.en: I cannot calculate this. I am not an engineer.
ex.zh: 我不是工程師，算不出來。

calculate.en: to find an amount or number by using mathematics

ex.en: We calculated that we could reach the place within two weeks.
ex.zh: 我們估計兩週內可以抵達那裡。

ex.en: We calculated that the project would take six months.
ex.zh: 我們估計這個專案需要六個月。

calculate.en: to think that something is likely after considering the facts

ex.en: I was calm until I saw the syringe.
ex.zh: 看到針筒之前我都很冷靜。

ex.en: Please stay calm and follow the instructions.
ex.zh: 請保持冷靜，遵照指示。

ex.en: The sea was calm this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早上海面很平靜。

calm.en: quiet and relaxed, not nervous or angry

ex.en: Tom has calmed down.
ex.zh: 湯姆已經冷靜下來了。

ex.en: Calm down and explain it from the beginning.
ex.zh: 你冷靜下來，從頭開始說。

ex.en: The wind calmed down.
ex.zh: 風平息了。

calm.en: to become quiet and relaxed, or to make someone feel this way

ex.en: Unplug all the cables.
ex.zh: 把所有的線都拔掉。

ex.en: I need a longer charging cable.
ex.zh: 我需要一條長一點的充電線。

cable.en: a thick wire that carries electricity or signals

ex.en: We don't have cable at home.
ex.zh: 我們家沒有裝第四台。

ex.en: Do you watch cable TV?
ex.zh: 你看有線電視嗎？

cable.en: a television service that comes through wires under the ground

ex.en: The boy reached out for another piece of cake.
ex.zh: 男孩伸手又拿了一塊蛋糕。

ex.en: This cake tastes like it has cheese in it.
ex.zh: 這塊蛋糕吃起來好像有加起司。

ex.en: My mother makes the best cakes in the world.
ex.zh: 我媽媽做的蛋糕是全世界最好吃的。

cake.en: a sweet food made from flour, eggs and sugar and baked in an oven

cake.zh: a piece of cake：小事一樁、輕而易舉

ex.en: Don't worry, the test was a piece of cake.
ex.zh: 別擔心，考試超簡單。

ex.en: Setting up the printer was a piece of cake.
ex.zh: 設定印表機簡直輕而易舉。

cake.en: something that is very easy to do

ex.en: The cap is too small for me.
ex.zh: 這頂帽子對我來說太小了。

ex.en: What is the price of this cap?
ex.zh: 這頂帽子多少錢？

ex.en: Take off your caps in the classroom!
ex.zh: 在教室裡請脫帽！

cap.en: a soft flat hat with a hard part at the front

ex.en: Put the cap back on the pen.
ex.zh: 把筆蓋蓋回去。

ex.en: I can't get the cap off this bottle.
ex.zh: 我打不開這個瓶蓋。

cap.en: a small cover for the top of a bottle, pen or tube

ex.en: There is a cap on how much you can spend.
ex.zh: 你能花的錢有上限。

ex.en: The government set a cap on rent increases.
ex.zh: 政府對租金漲幅設了上限。

cap.en: a limit on the amount that can be spent or charged

ex.en: The company capped prices at 100 dollars.
ex.zh: 公司把價格上限定在一百元。

ex.en: Class sizes are capped at twenty students.
ex.zh: 每班人數上限為二十人。

cap.en: to put a limit on an amount

ex.en: My classmate, Xiao Ming, has strong managerial capability.
ex.zh: 我同學小明的管理能力很強。

ex.en: The new phone has impressive camera capabilities.
ex.zh: 這支新手機的相機功能很強大。

ex.en: We need to improve our production capability.
ex.zh: 我們需要提升生產能力。

capability.en: the ability or power to do something

ex.en: Trees give off oxygen and absorb carbon dioxide.
ex.zh: 樹木會釋放氧氣、吸收二氧化碳。

ex.en: The company aims to reduce its carbon emissions by half.
ex.zh: 公司的目標是把碳排放量減半。

carbon.en: a chemical element found in all living things, and in coal and diamonds

carbon.zh: carbon copy：副本（郵件 CC）；翻版

ex.en: He is a carbon copy of his father.
ex.zh: 他簡直是他爸爸的翻版。

ex.en: Please send a carbon copy of the email to my manager.
ex.zh: 請把這封信的副本寄給我的主管。

carbon.en: an exact copy of something, or a person who looks or acts just like another

ex.en: We must buy a new carpet for this room.
ex.zh: 我們得為這個房間買一塊新地毯。

ex.en: White carpets are very hard to keep clean.
ex.zh: 白色地毯很難保持乾淨。

ex.en: Curtains and carpets were renewed.
ex.zh: 窗簾和地毯都換新了。

carpet.en: a thick soft cover for a floor

ex.en: The floor is carpeted.
ex.zh: 地板上鋪著地毯。

ex.en: The hallway was carpeted last year.
ex.zh: 走廊去年鋪了地毯。

ex.en: The ground was carpeted with fallen leaves.
ex.zh: 地面鋪滿了落葉。

carpet.en: to cover a floor with a thick soft cover, or to cover a place with something

ex.en: Milk is a good source of calcium.
ex.zh: 牛奶是鈣質的良好來源。

ex.en: You need calcium for strong bones.
ex.zh: 你需要鈣質來強健骨骼。

calcium.en: a chemical element in milk and bones that makes them strong

ex.en: Last year I was a TA for calculus.
ex.zh: 去年我當微積分課的助教。

ex.en: I'm taking calculus this semester.
ex.zh: 我這學期修微積分。

calculus.en: a type of advanced mathematics about change and movement

ex.en: Capillaries carry blood to every part of the body.
ex.zh: 微血管把血液送到身體每個部位。

ex.en: Capillaries are the smallest blood vessels.
ex.zh: 微血管是最小的血管。

capillary.en: a very thin tube, especially one that carries blood in the body

ex.en: Taiwan's GDP per capita has grown steadily.
ex.zh: 台灣的人均國內生產毛額穩定成長。

ex.en: The country spends more per capita on health care than its neighbors.
ex.zh: 這個國家每人的醫療支出比鄰國高。

capita.en: for each person in a group or country

ex.en: We drove to the cape to watch the sunset.
ex.zh: 我們開車到海角看夕陽。

ex.en: There is a lighthouse at the tip of the cape.
ex.zh: 海角的尖端有一座燈塔。

cape.en: a large piece of land that sticks out into the sea

ex.en: The boy wore a red cape like a superhero.
ex.zh: 那個男孩像超級英雄一樣披著紅色披風。

ex.en: She put a warm cape over her shoulders.
ex.zh: 她在肩上披了一件保暖的斗篷。

cape.en: a loose coat without sleeves that hangs from the shoulders

ex.en: I met her at 8:30p.m at the cathedral.
ex.zh: 我和她晚上八點半在大教堂碰面。

ex.en: The cathedral is the city's most famous landmark.
ex.zh: 那座大教堂是這座城市最有名的地標。

ex.en: Our tour group visited the old cathedral.
ex.zh: 我們的旅行團參觀了那座古老的大教堂。

cathedral.en: a large and important Christian church

ex.en: We hiked to the bottom of the canyon.
ex.zh: 我們健行到峽谷底部。

ex.en: Taroko is famous for its deep marble canyon.
ex.zh: 太魯閣以深邃的大理石峽谷聞名。

canyon.en: a deep valley with steep sides, often with a river at the bottom

ex.en: We've got some catching up to do.
ex.zh: 我們得好好敘敘舊了。

ex.en: We have lots of catching up to do.
ex.zh: 我們有好多近況要聊。

ex.en: Let's grab coffee and catch up this weekend.
ex.zh: 這週末一起喝杯咖啡聊聊近況吧。

catch up.en: to talk with someone to learn what has happened since you last met

ex.en: If you hurry, you will catch up with him.
ex.zh: 你快一點的話就能追上他。

ex.en: Start right now, and you'll catch up with them.
ex.zh: 你馬上出發，就可以趕上他們了。

ex.en: Japan has caught up with America in some fields.
ex.zh: 日本在某些領域已經趕上了美國。

catch up.en: to reach someone who is ahead of you by going faster

ex.en: Currently, my sister works as a cashier at a supermarket.
ex.zh: 目前，我妹妹在一家超市當收銀員。

ex.en: Mary works as a cashier.
ex.zh: 瑪麗是個收銀員。

ex.en: Pay the cashier on the way out.
ex.zh: 出去時在收銀台付錢。

cashier.en: a person who takes payments from customers in a shop or bank

ex.en: I haven't got any cash. Can I write a cheque?
ex.zh: 我沒有現金，可以開支票嗎？

ex.en: Tom handed the envelope full of cash to Mary.
ex.zh: 湯姆把裝滿現金的信封遞給瑪麗。

ex.en: Did you bring cash or your credit card with you?
ex.zh: 你帶了現金還是信用卡？

cash.en: money in the form of paper notes and coins

ex.en: I'd like to cash a travelers' check.
ex.zh: 我想兌現一張旅行支票。

ex.en: You can cash the check at any branch.
ex.zh: 你可以在任何一家分行兌現這張支票。

cash.en: to exchange a cheque for money

ex.en: Tom and Mary went camping in the mountains.
ex.zh: 湯姆和瑪麗去山裡露營。

ex.en: The sunny weather made camping even more fun.
ex.zh: 晴朗的天氣讓露營更好玩了。

ex.en: Tom doesn't have any friends who like camping.
ex.zh: 湯姆沒有喜歡露營的朋友。

camping.en: the activity of staying in a tent outdoors for fun

ex.en: I found the course in the university catalogue.
ex.zh: 我在大學的課程一覽中找到了那門課。

ex.en: The library has an online catalogue of all its books.
ex.zh: 圖書館有一份所有藏書的線上目錄。

catalogue.en: a book that lists things such as courses or goods for sale

ex.en: Brahe catalogued over 1000 stars.
ex.zh: 布拉赫為一千多顆恆星做了編目。

ex.en: The librarian catalogued the new books on Monday.
ex.zh: 圖書館員在週一為新書編了目。

catalogue.en: to make a complete list of things

ex.en: The artist stretched a blank canvas over the frame.
ex.zh: 畫家把空白的畫布繃在畫框上。

ex.en: She painted a sunset on a large canvas.
ex.zh: 她在一大幅畫布上畫了日落。

canvas.en: strong cloth used by artists for painting on

ex.en: My cassette tape recorder needs fixing.
ex.zh: 我的磁帶錄音機需要維修。

ex.en: He still keeps his favorite songs on a cassette.
ex.zh: 他還把最愛的歌曲存在一捲卡式磁帶上。

cassette.en: a small plastic case with tape inside for recording or playing sound

ex.en: Tom is being held captive.
ex.zh: 湯姆被囚禁了。

ex.en: The soldiers were held captive for two months.
ex.zh: 那些士兵被囚禁了兩個月。

captive.en: kept as a prisoner and not free to leave

ex.en: My parents live a carefree life in the countryside.
ex.zh: 我父母在鄉村過著無憂無慮的生活。

ex.en: Summer vacation is a carefree time for children.
ex.zh: 暑假對孩子來說是無憂無慮的時光。

ex.en: Don't worry, a broken arm isn't catching.
ex.zh: 別擔心，手臂骨折又不會傳染。

ex.en: Her laughter was so catching that everyone started to smile.
ex.zh: 她的笑聲很有感染力，大家都跟著笑了。

catching.en: able to pass from one person to another

ex.en: Take one capsule three times a day after meals.
ex.zh: 一天三次，飯後各服一顆膠囊。

ex.en: Swallow the capsule whole with a glass of water.
ex.zh: 配一杯水把膠囊整顆吞下。

capsule.en: a small tube of medicine that you swallow

ex.en: This building is a capsule hotel lodging men and women.
ex.zh: 這棟建築是男女都能入住的膠囊旅館。

ex.en: The space capsule landed safely in the ocean.
ex.zh: 太空艙安全降落在海上。

capsule.en: a small closed space or container, such as the part of a spacecraft where people stay

ex.en: The dentist found two cavities in my back teeth.
ex.zh: 牙醫在我的後排牙齒找到兩顆蛀牙。

ex.en: Brushing after meals helps prevent cavities.
ex.zh: 飯後刷牙有助於預防蛀牙。

cavity.en: a hole in a tooth caused by decay

ex.en: The heart and lungs are in the chest cavity.
ex.zh: 心臟和肺位於胸腔內。

ex.en: Water had collected in a small cavity in the rock.
ex.zh: 水積在岩石的一個小洞裡。

cavity.en: an empty space inside something solid or inside the body

ex.en: Honesty is the cardinal rule in our family.
ex.zh: 誠實是我們家最重要的規矩。

ex.en: Respect is one of the cardinal principles of good teamwork.
ex.zh: 尊重是良好團隊合作的基本原則之一。

ex.en: The cardinal led the prayer in the old cathedral.
ex.zh: 樞機主教在古老的大教堂裡帶領禱告。

ex.en: A cardinal from Rome visited our church last week.
ex.zh: 一位來自羅馬的樞機主教上週來訪我們的教堂。

cardinal.en: a senior priest in the Catholic Church

ex.en: The prime minister announced a new cabinet.
ex.zh: 總理宣布了新內閣名單。

ex.en: The cabinet meets every Thursday.
ex.zh: 內閣每週四開會。

cabinet.en: the group of senior ministers who help lead a government

ex.en: The tablecloth is in the cabinet.
ex.zh: 桌巾在櫃子裡。

ex.en: The book fell from the cabinet.
ex.zh: 書從櫃子上掉了下來。

cabinet.en: a piece of furniture with doors or drawers for storing things

ex.en: London, the capital of England, is on the Thames.
ex.zh: 英國首都倫敦位於泰晤士河畔。

ex.en: My uncle lives in Madrid, the capital of Spain.
ex.zh: 我叔叔住在西班牙的首都馬德里。

capital.en: the city where a country's government is based

ex.en: The firm went under due to lack of capital.
ex.zh: 那家公司因為缺乏資金而倒閉了。

ex.en: You need capital to start a business.
ex.zh: 創業需要資金。

capital.en: money that is used to start or run a business

ex.en: Write your name in capitals.
ex.zh: 用大寫字母寫你的名字。

ex.en: Write the alphabet in capitals.
ex.zh: 用大寫寫出字母表。

capital.en: a large letter used at the start of a name or sentence

ex.en: The cargo ship arrived four hours early.
ex.zh: 貨船提早了四個小時抵達。

ex.en: The ship was carrying a cargo of rice.
ex.zh: 那艘船載著一船稻米。

cargo.en: goods carried by a ship, plane or truck

carrier.zh: 運輸業者、航空公司；（電信）業者

ex.en: The airline is the country's largest carrier.
ex.zh: 這家航空公司是該國最大的航空業者。

ex.en: Which mobile carrier do you use?
ex.zh: 你用哪一家電信業者？

carrier.en: a company that moves people or goods, or provides phone services

ex.en: Has the letter carrier been by yet?
ex.zh: 郵差來過了嗎？

ex.en: Mosquitoes are carriers of disease.
ex.zh: 蚊子會傳播疾病。

carrier.en: a person who takes things from one place to another

ex.en: This factory's productive capacity is 250 cars a week.
ex.zh: 這家工廠每週的產能是 250 輛車。

ex.en: The room has a seating capacity of 200.
ex.zh: 這個房間可以容納 200 個座位。

ex.en: The bus was filled to capacity.
ex.zh: 這輛公車客滿了。

capacity.en: the amount that a place can hold or a machine can produce

ex.en: Man has a great capacity to adapt to environmental changes.
ex.zh: 人類適應環境變化的能力很強。

ex.en: The cells have the capacity to convert food into energy.
ex.zh: 細胞具有將食物轉化為能量的能力。

capacity.en: the ability to do or understand something

ex.en: She attended the meeting in her capacity as manager.
ex.zh: 她以經理的身分出席會議。

ex.en: He worked for us in an advisory capacity.
ex.zh: 他以顧問的身分替我們工作。

capacity.en: the position or job that someone has when they do something

ex.en: The scale needs calibration every six months.
ex.zh: 這台秤每六個月需要校準一次。

ex.en: Incorrect calibration can lead to bad data.
ex.zh: 校準不正確會導致資料錯誤。

calibration.en: the act of adjusting a tool so that it measures correctly

ex.en: Who is doing the catering for the wedding?
ex.zh: 婚禮的外燴是誰負責的？

ex.en: She runs a small catering business.
ex.zh: 她經營一家小型外燴公司。

catering.en: the job of providing food and drink for events

ex.en: We started a campaign against smoking.
ex.zh: 我們發起了一項反菸運動。

ex.en: The new ad campaign was very successful.
ex.zh: 新的廣告宣傳活動非常成功。

campaign.en: a planned set of actions to achieve a social or business goal

ex.en: Lobbyists for the bill funneled bribes into a campaign fund.
ex.zh: 支持這項法案的說客把賄款轉入競選基金。

ex.en: She spent millions on her election campaign.
ex.zh: 她在競選活動上花了數百萬。

campaign.en: a series of events to try to win an election

ex.en: A local restaurant catered the wedding.
ex.zh: 一家本地餐廳承辦了婚宴。

ex.en: We cater for parties of up to 200 people.
ex.zh: 我們承辦最多兩百人的宴會。

cater.en: to provide food and drink for an event

ex.en: This is a store that caters specially to students.
ex.zh: 這是一家專門為學生服務的商店。

ex.en: The hotel caters to business travelers.
ex.zh: 這家飯店主要服務商務旅客。

cater.en: to provide what a certain group of people want or need

ex.en: Please send a carbon copy of the budget email to the regional manager.
ex.zh: 請將預算郵件副本寄給區域經理。

ex.en: I sent a carbon copy of the signed contract to our accountant.
ex.zh: 我把已簽署合約的副本寄給會計師。

carbon copy.en: an extra copy of a message sent to someone, or the part of an email for these people

ex.en: Opening a second branch put pressure on the company’s cash flow.
ex.zh: 開設第二家分店讓公司的現金流承受壓力。

ex.en: The finance team reviews cash flow before approving major purchases.
ex.zh: 財務團隊會在核准大型採購前檢視現金流。

cash flow.en: the movement of money coming into and going out of a business

ex.en: The browser stores images in its cache.
ex.zh: 瀏覽器會將圖片存入快取。

ex.en: Clearing the cache may solve the loading problem.
ex.zh: 清除快取或許能解決載入問題。

cache.en: a part of a computer's memory that stores data so it can be found quickly

ex.en: Three coworkers carpool to the office every morning.
ex.zh: 三位同事每天早上共乘上班。

ex.en: We carpooled to the conference to reduce parking costs.
ex.zh: 我們共乘前往研討會，以降低停車費。

carpool.en: to travel to work or school together in one car with other people

ex.en: Please keep the aisle clear inside the train carriage.
ex.zh: 請保持列車車廂走道淨空。

ex.en: The fee covers the carriage of fragile equipment.
ex.zh: 這筆費用包含易碎設備的運送。

carriage.en: a section of a train for passengers, or the act of carrying goods

ex.en: The cashier found the missing receipt beside the cash register.
ex.zh: 收銀員在收銀機旁找到遺失的收據。

ex.en: The manager counted the cash register after closing.
ex.zh: 打烊後，經理清點了收銀機裡的現金。

cash register.en: a machine in a shop that records sales and holds the money

ex.en: The seaside town holds a carnival every August.
ex.zh: 這座海濱小鎮每年八月都會舉辦嘉年華。

ex.en: Local schools organized a carnival to raise money for the library.
ex.zh: 當地學校舉辦園遊會，為圖書館募款。

carnival.en: a public festival with music, games and colourful events

ex.en: She has a lot of carry-on luggage.
ex.zh: 她有很多隨身行李。

ex.en: Liquids in your carry-on bag must be under 100 milliliters.
ex.zh: 隨身行李中的液體每瓶不得超過 100 毫升。

carry-on.en: small enough to be taken with you into the cabin of a plane

ex.en: You can bring one carry-on and one personal item.
ex.zh: 你可以帶一件隨身行李和一件個人物品。

ex.en: Please put your carry-on in the overhead bin.
ex.zh: 請把隨身行李放進上方的置物櫃。

carry-on.en: a small bag that you take with you on a plane

ex.en: We must cancel our trip to Japan.
ex.zh: 我們必須取消我們去日本的旅行。

ex.en: Tom's flight was delayed and then cancelled.
ex.zh: 湯姆的航班延誤了，然後被取消了。

ex.en: Jack decided to cancel the reservations.
ex.zh: 傑克決定取消預訂。

cancel.en: to decide that a planned event will not happen

ex.en: My plan is visiting old castles in Scotland.
ex.zh: 我的計劃是參觀蘇格蘭的古堡。

ex.en: The site of the castle is now a park.
ex.zh: 城堡的舊址現在變成了公園。

ex.en: In the background of the picture is a castle.
ex.zh: 圖片的背景是一座城堡。

castle.en: a large strong old building with thick walls, built to defend against attack

ex.en: Please send me your latest product catalog.
ex.zh: 請寄給我你們最新的產品型錄。

ex.en: You can find the price in the catalog.
ex.zh: 價格可以在型錄上查到。

catalog.en: a book that lists things such as goods for sale

ex.en: We were just talking about you when you called.
ex.zh: 你打電話來的時候，我們正好在聊你。

ex.en: I'll give you a call when I get home.
ex.zh: 我到家後給你打電話。

ex.en: This weekend we can make telephone calls for free.
ex.zh: 這個週末我們可以免費打電話。

ex.en: I missed three calls during the meeting.
ex.zh: 我開會時漏接了三通電話。

call.en: an act of phoning someone, or the conversation that happens

ex.en: He got mad at me for calling him Shorty.
ex.zh: 我把他叫做「矮子」，他就氣得不得了。

ex.en: President Lincoln was what we call a self-made man.
ex.zh: 林肯總統就是我們所說的白手起家的人。

call.en: to give someone or something a name or describe them in a certain way

ex.en: The picnic was called off because of the rain.
ex.zh: 野餐因為下雨取消了。

ex.en: They called off the meeting at the last minute.
ex.zh: 他們在最後一刻取消了會議。

call.en: to decide that a planned event will not happen

ex.en: I will call back a bit later.
ex.zh: 我晚一點再回電。

ex.en: Can you ask her to call me back?
ex.zh: 可以請她回電給我嗎？

call back.en: to phone someone again, or to phone someone who phoned you

ex.en: He was the strongest candidate for the position.
ex.zh: 他是那個職位最有希望的候選人。

ex.en: Ideally, a candidate for this job should have four years' work experience.
ex.zh: 這個職位最理想的應徵者要有四年工作經驗。

candidate.en: a person who applies for a job

ex.en: He is one of the candidates running for mayor.
ex.zh: 他是市長的候選人之一。

ex.en: Strange to say, no one voted for the candidate.
ex.zh: 說也奇怪，沒有人投票給那位候選人。

candidate.en: a person who is trying to be chosen in an election

ex.en: She wants to go to Beijing to further her career.
ex.zh: 她想去北京發展她的事業。

ex.en: He always kept an open mind about his future career.
ex.zh: 他對未來的職涯一直抱持開放的態度。

ex.en: His political career is done for.
ex.zh: 他的政治生涯完蛋了。

career.en: the series of jobs that a person has in their working life

ex.en: We took a boat ride along the canal.
ex.zh: 我們沿著運河搭船遊覽。

ex.en: The canal connects the river to the sea.
ex.zh: 這條運河連接河流與大海。

ex.en: Many old canals are now used for tourism.
ex.zh: 許多古老的運河現在用於觀光。

ex.en: We found a small cave near the top of the mountain.
ex.zh: 我們在山頂附近發現了一個小洞穴。

ex.en: Bats sleep in the dark cave during the day.
ex.zh: 蝙蝠白天在黑暗的洞穴裡睡覺。

ex.en: The children were afraid to go into the cave alone.
ex.zh: 孩子們不敢一個人走進洞穴。

cave.zh: 塌陷；屈服（常用 cave in）

ex.en: The roof of the old house caved in after the heavy rain.
ex.zh: 那間老房子的屋頂在大雨後塌了下來。

ex.en: After hours of arguing, he finally caved in and said yes.
ex.zh: 爭論了好幾個小時後，他終於讓步答應了。

ex.en: He likes to carve small animals out of wood.
ex.zh: 他喜歡用木頭雕刻小動物。

ex.en: They carved their names into the old tree.
ex.zh: 他們把名字刻在那棵老樹上。

ex.en: Children carve pumpkins for Halloween every year.
ex.zh: 孩子們每年萬聖節都會雕南瓜。

ex.en: Dad will carve the turkey at the table.
ex.zh: 爸爸會在餐桌上切火雞肉。

ex.en: She carved the roast into thin slices.
ex.zh: 她把烤肉切成薄片。

ex.en: Rice and bread are rich in carbohydrates.
ex.zh: 米飯和麵包富含碳水化合物。

ex.en: Athletes often eat carbohydrate before a big race.
ex.zh: 運動員在大型比賽前常會攝取碳水化合物。

ex.en: She lit a candle on the birthday cake.
ex.zh: 她在生日蛋糕上點了一根蠟燭。

ex.en: The power went out, so we used candles.
ex.zh: 停電了，所以我們點蠟燭。

ex.en: He blew out the candle before going to bed.
ex.zh: 他睡前把蠟燭吹熄。

ex.en: She works as a carer for elderly people.
ex.zh: 她的工作是照顧年長者。

ex.en: Carers need rest and support, too.
ex.zh: 照顧者也需要休息和支持。

ex.en: My little brother watches a cartoon every Saturday morning.
ex.zh: 我弟弟每個星期六早上都會看卡通。

ex.en: The newspaper prints a funny cartoon on the last page.
ex.zh: 這份報紙在最後一頁刊登一幅有趣的漫畫。

ex.en: He cartoons for a local magazine in his spare time.
ex.zh: 他在空閒時為一本地方雜誌畫漫畫。

ex.en: The artist cartooned the mayor with an oversized nose.
ex.zh: 畫家把市長畫成鼻子特別大的漫畫。

ex.en: I cut a carrot into small pieces for the soup.
ex.zh: 我把一根胡蘿蔔切成小塊煮湯。

ex.en: Rabbits love eating fresh carrots.
ex.zh: 兔子很愛吃新鮮的胡蘿蔔。

ex.en: The company used a bonus as a carrot to motivate workers.
ex.zh: 公司用獎金當誘因來激勵員工。

ex.en: Some teachers prefer a carrot to a stick.
ex.zh: 有些老師偏好用獎勵而非懲罰。

ex.en: They spent the summer traveling in a caravan.
ex.zh: 他們夏天開著露營拖車到處旅行。

ex.en: We parked our caravan next to the lake.
ex.zh: 我們把露營拖車停在湖邊。

ex.en: A caravan of camels crossed the desert slowly.
ex.zh: 一支駱駝商隊緩慢地穿越沙漠。

ex.en: Traders once traveled in caravans along the old road.
ex.zh: 商人過去會結伴組成商隊走在古老的道路上。

ex.en: She is a Catholic and goes to church every Sunday.
ex.zh: 她是天主教徒，每個星期天都去教堂。

ex.en: Many Catholics visit the cathedral during Easter.
ex.zh: 許多天主教徒在復活節期間造訪大教堂。

ex.en: The Catholic church in our town is over a hundred years old.
ex.zh: 我們鎮上的天主教堂已有一百多年歷史。

ex.en: He has catholic tastes in music and enjoys almost every style.
ex.zh: 他的音樂品味很廣泛，幾乎每種風格都喜歡。

ex.en: Cambridge is a university city in England.
ex.zh: 劍橋是英格蘭的一座大學城。

ex.en: Tourists enjoy a boat ride along the river in Cambridge.
ex.zh: 遊客喜歡在劍橋沿著河搭船遊覽。

ex.en: She is a Canadian citizen who lives in Taipei.
ex.zh: 她是住在台北的加拿大公民。

ex.en: We bought some Canadian maple syrup at the market.
ex.zh: 我們在市場買了一些加拿大楓糖漿。

ex.en: The Canadian winter can be long and very cold.
ex.zh: 加拿大的冬天可能又長又冷。

ex.en: Canada is the second largest country in the world by area.
ex.zh: 以面積來說，加拿大是世界第二大國。

ex.en: My cousin moved to Canada to study engineering.
ex.zh: 我表哥搬到加拿大去念工程。

ex.en: California is on the west coast of the United States.
ex.zh: 加州位於美國的西岸。

ex.en: We drove along the coast of California last summer.
ex.zh: 去年夏天我們沿著加州海岸開車旅行。

ex.en: Caroline works at a flower shop downtown.
ex.zh: 卡洛琳在市區的一間花店工作。

ex.en: Caroline reminded us to bring our passports.
ex.zh: 卡洛琳提醒我們要帶護照。

ex.en: Cardiff is the capital city of Wales.
ex.zh: 加的夫是威爾斯的首府。

ex.en: We watched a football match in Cardiff last weekend.
ex.zh: 我們上週末在加的夫看了一場足球賽。

ex.en: Catherine is a classic name for girls.
ex.zh: 凱瑟琳是個經典的女孩名字。

ex.en: Catherine the Great ruled Russia for many years.
ex.zh: 葉卡捷琳娜大帝統治俄羅斯多年。

ex.en: Campbell is a well-known surname in Scotland.
ex.zh: 坎貝爾是蘇格蘭著名的姓氏。

ex.en: The speaker introduced herself as Ms. Campbell.
ex.zh: 講者自我介紹說她是坎貝爾女士。

ex.en: The carter loaded the sacks of flour onto his wagon.
ex.zh: 那位馬車伕把幾袋麵粉裝上他的貨車。

ex.en: In the old days, a carter delivered goods between villages.
ex.zh: 從前，馬車伕負責在村落之間運送貨物。

canterbury.zh: 坎特伯里（英格蘭東南部的城市，以大教堂聞名）

ex.en: Canterbury is a city in the southeast of England.
ex.zh: 坎特伯里是英格蘭東南部的一座城市。

ex.en: Thousands of visitors come to see the cathedral in Canterbury.
ex.zh: 成千上萬的遊客來參觀坎特伯里的大教堂。

ex.en: Scientists found a causal link between smoking and lung disease.
ex.zh: 科學家發現吸菸與肺部疾病之間有因果關係。

ex.en: It is hard to prove a causal relationship from this small study.
ex.zh: 很難從這項小規模研究證明因果關係。

ex.en: The old man walks with a wooden cane.
ex.zh: 那位老先生拄著木頭手杖走路。

ex.en: After the surgery, she needed a cane for a few weeks.
ex.zh: 手術後，她有幾個星期需要用拐杖。

ex.en: Sugar cane grows well in warm and wet places.
ex.zh: 甘蔗在溫暖潮濕的地方生長得很好。

ex.en: The chair was woven from thin pieces of cane.
ex.zh: 那張椅子是用細藤條編成的。

ex.en: The runner pulled a muscle in his calf.
ex.zh: 那位跑者的小腿肌肉拉傷了。

ex.en: My calves were sore after climbing the stairs.
ex.zh: 爬完樓梯後我的小腿很痠。

ex.en: The calf stayed close to its mother in the field.
ex.zh: 小牛在田野裡緊跟著牠的母親。

ex.en: A newborn calf can stand within an hour.
ex.zh: 剛出生的小牛一個小時內就能站起來。

ex.en: They spent their honeymoon on a Caribbean island.
ex.zh: 他們在一座加勒比海島嶼度蜜月。

ex.en: Caribbean music is popular for its lively rhythm.
ex.zh: 加勒比海地區的音樂以活潑的節奏聞名。

ex.en: The ship sailed through the Caribbean for two weeks.
ex.zh: 那艘船在加勒比海航行了兩個星期。

ex.en: The water in the Caribbean is warm and clear.
ex.zh: 加勒比海的海水溫暖又清澈。

ex.en: The children sang a carol at the Christmas party.
ex.zh: 孩子們在聖誕派對上唱了一首聖誕頌歌。

ex.en: We heard carols coming from the church on Christmas Eve.
ex.zh: 聖誕夜我們聽到教堂傳來頌歌聲。

ex.en: She works as a caregiver for elderly people at home.
ex.zh: 她的工作是在家照顧年長者的看護。

ex.en: A caregiver needs a lot of patience and kindness.
ex.zh: 照顧者需要很多耐心與善意。

ex.en: The children's main caregiver is their grandmother.
ex.zh: 孩子們的主要照顧者是他們的奶奶。

ex.en: She calmly explained what had happened.
ex.zh: 她冷靜地說明了發生的事。

ex.en: He calmly waited for the results of the test.
ex.zh: 他平靜地等著考試結果。

ex.en: We rented a canoe and paddled across the lake.
ex.zh: 我們租了一艘獨木舟，划過湖面。

ex.en: The canoe slid quietly through the water.
ex.zh: 獨木舟悄悄地滑過水面。

ex.en: They canoed down the river for three days.
ex.zh: 他們划獨木舟沿河而下三天。

ex.en: I'd love to go canoeing this weekend.
ex.zh: 我很想這個週末去划獨木舟。

ex.en: He casually mentioned that he was moving to Tainan.
ex.zh: 他不經意地提到自己要搬去台南。

ex.en: She walked into the room as casually as she could.
ex.zh: 她盡可能若無其事地走進房間。

ex.en: Everyone at the picnic was dressed casually.
ex.zh: 野餐的每個人都穿得很休閒。

ex.en: You can dress casually on Fridays at our office.
ex.zh: 我們公司星期五可以穿便服。

ex.en: She is a well-known campaigner for clean water.
ex.zh: 她是知名的潔淨水倡議者。

ex.en: The campaigner handed out flyers outside the station.
ex.zh: 那位倡議人士在車站外發傳單。

ex.en: Carolyn is a girl's name in English.
ex.zh: Carolyn 是英文的女孩名字。

ex.en: Carolyn teaches music at a primary school.
ex.zh: 卡洛琳在一所小學教音樂。

ex.en: She is a caring teacher who listens to every student.
ex.zh: 她是一位傾聽每位學生的貼心老師。

ex.en: My neighbor is a kind and caring person.
ex.zh: 我的鄰居是個善良又有愛心的人。

ex.en: The tourists rode a camel across the desert.
ex.zh: 遊客騎著駱駝穿越沙漠。

ex.en: A camel can go several days without water.
ex.zh: 駱駝可以好幾天不喝水。

ex.en: Mom put thin slices of cabbage in the salad.
ex.zh: 媽媽在沙拉裡加了切成薄片的高麗菜。

ex.en: The farmer grows cabbage and carrots in his garden.
ex.zh: 農夫在他的菜園裡種高麗菜和紅蘿蔔。

ex.en: We ate canned beans and rice during the camping trip.
ex.zh: 露營時我們吃罐頭豆子和米飯。

ex.en: Fresh fruit tastes better than canned fruit.
ex.zh: 新鮮水果比罐頭水果好吃。

ex.en: The comedy show uses canned laughter after every joke.
ex.zh: 這個喜劇節目在每個笑話後都放預錄的笑聲。

ex.en: I got a canned reply instead of a real answer.
ex.zh: 我收到的是制式的回覆，而不是真正的答覆。

ex.en: The bed had a white canopy that hung from four poles.
ex.zh: 那張床有一個從四根柱子垂下的白色帳篷。

ex.en: We sat under a canopy to avoid the sun.
ex.zh: 我們坐在遮篷下避開太陽。

ex.en: Sunlight barely reached the ground beneath the thick forest canopy.
ex.zh: 陽光幾乎照不到濃密森林樹冠下的地面。

ex.en: Monkeys travel through the canopy from tree to tree.
ex.zh: 猴子在樹冠層間從一棵樹移動到另一棵樹。

ex.en: He cautiously opened the door and looked inside.
ex.zh: 他小心翼翼地打開門往裡看。

ex.en: The investors are cautiously optimistic about next year.
ex.zh: 投資人對明年抱持審慎樂觀的態度。

ex.en: We usually have lunch in the school canteen.
ex.zh: 我們通常在學校餐廳吃午餐。

ex.en: The factory canteen serves cheap hot meals every day.

ex.en: We drove from Sydney to Canberra in about three hours.
ex.zh: 我們開車從雪梨到坎培拉大約花了三小時。

ex.en: As a child, she learned the catechism at Sunday school.
ex.zh: 她小時候在主日學學過教理問答。

ex.en: The priest taught the catechism to the young students.
ex.zh: 神父向年輕學生教授教理問答。

ex.en: She spoke candidly about her mistakes.
ex.zh: 她坦率地談起自己的錯誤。

ex.en: Candidly, I think the plan needs more work.
ex.zh: 坦白說，我覺得這個計畫還需要改進。

ex.en: Cannibalism is rare in the animal world, but it does happen.
ex.zh: 同類相食在動物界很少見，但確實會發生。

ex.en: The explorer's story of cannibalism turned out to be a legend.
ex.zh: 探險家說的食人故事後來證實只是傳說。

ex.en: The workers are capping the bottles at the end of the line.
ex.zh: 工人們在生產線的末端為瓶子蓋上蓋子。

ex.en: The city is capping rent increases at three percent a year.
ex.zh: 市政府正把年度租金漲幅限制在百分之三以內。

ex.en: The caddie handed him a seven iron.
ex.zh: 球童遞給他一支七號鐵桿。

ex.en: She worked as a caddie at the golf club every summer.
ex.zh: 她每年夏天都在高爾夫球場當球童。

ex.en: He caddied for his uncle during the weekend tournament.
ex.zh: 他在週末的比賽中替叔叔當球童。

ex.en: I caddied at a local course when I was a teenager.
ex.zh: 我十幾歲時在當地球場當過球童。

ex.en: The doctor removed the cancerous cells early.
ex.zh: 醫生及早切除了癌細胞。

ex.en: Tests showed that the lump was not cancerous.
ex.zh: 檢查顯示那個腫塊不是癌性的。

ex.en: We went canoeing on the lake last weekend.
ex.zh: 上週末我們去湖上划獨木舟。

ex.en: Canoeing is a great way to enjoy quiet rivers.
ex.zh: 划獨木舟是享受寧靜河流的好方法。

ex.en: She learned canoeing at a summer camp.
ex.zh: 她在夏令營學會了划獨木舟。

ex.en: He was given the captaincy of the football team.
ex.zh: 他被任命為足球隊的隊長。

ex.en: Her captaincy lasted three successful seasons.
ex.zh: 她擔任隊長的三個球季都很成功。

ex.en: The children laughed as the carousel went around.
ex.zh: 旋轉木馬轉動時孩子們開心地笑著。

ex.en: She chose a white horse on the carousel.
ex.zh: 她在旋轉木馬上挑了一匹白馬。

ex.en: We waited at the carousel for our suitcases.
ex.zh: 我們在行李轉盤旁等著領行李。

ex.en: My bag was the last to come out on the carousel.
ex.zh: 我的行李是最後一個從轉盤上出來的。

ex.en: The weather in the mountains is capricious.
ex.zh: 山區的天氣變化無常。

ex.en: The capricious king changed his mind every day.
ex.zh: 那位反覆無常的國王每天都改變主意。

ex.en: She has a capricious taste in music.
ex.zh: 她對音樂的喜好多變難測。

ex.en: The chair has a caster on each leg.
ex.zh: 這張椅子每隻腳都裝有一個腳輪。

ex.en: One caster broke, so the table won't roll smoothly.
ex.zh: 有個腳輪壞了，所以桌子推不順。

catchy.zh: （旋律、標語）好記的、朗朗上口的

ex.en: The song has a catchy tune I can't forget.
ex.zh: 這首歌的旋律很洗腦，我忘不掉。

ex.en: They came up with a catchy slogan for the shop.
ex.zh: 他們為店裡想出了一句好記的標語。

ex.en: Cameroon is a country in Central Africa.
ex.zh: 喀麥隆是中非的一個國家。

ex.en: The football team from Cameroon played well.
ex.zh: 喀麥隆的足球隊表現得很好。

ex.en: My grandmother taught me home canning of fruit.
ex.zh: 我奶奶教我在家把水果裝罐保存。

ex.en: The canning factory hires workers every summer.
ex.zh: 那間罐頭工廠每年夏天都會招人。

ex.en: I had a slice of cantaloupe for breakfast.
ex.zh: 我早餐吃了一片哈密瓜。

ex.en: A ripe cantaloupe smells sweet at the stem end.
ex.zh: 熟透的哈密瓜在蒂的那端聞起來很甜。

cannibal.zh: 食人者；同類相食的動物

ex.en: The story is about explorers who were captured by cannibals.
ex.zh: 這個故事講的是被食人族俘虜的探險者。

ex.en: Some spiders are cannibals and eat their own kind.
ex.zh: 有些蜘蛛會同類相食。

ex.en: She placed a silver candlestick in the middle of the table.
ex.zh: 她把一個銀製燭台放在桌子中央。

ex.en: The brass candlestick was an old family gift.
ex.zh: 那個黃銅燭台是家裡傳下來的老禮物。

ex.en: The ring has a one-carat diamond.
ex.zh: 這枚戒指上有一顆一克拉的鑽石。

ex.en: A carat is a unit used to weigh gems.
ex.zh: 克拉是用來衡量寶石重量的單位。

ex.en: This necklace is made of 18 carat gold.
ex.zh: 這條項鍊是用十八開金製成的。

ex.en: Pure gold is 24 carat.
ex.zh: 純金是二十四開。

ex.en: I roasted cauliflower with olive oil and garlic.
ex.zh: 我用橄欖油和大蒜烤了花椰菜。

ex.en: Cauliflower is white and has a mild taste.
ex.zh: 花椰菜是白色的，味道溫和。

ex.en: The singer gave a captivating performance.
ex.zh: 那位歌手帶來了迷人的表演。

ex.en: She has a captivating smile that charms everyone.
ex.zh: 她有著迷人的笑容，讓每個人都傾倒。

ex.en: The city was forced to capitulate after a long siege.
ex.zh: 那座城市在長期圍困後被迫投降。

ex.en: The company finally capitulated to the workers' demands.
ex.zh: 公司最後屈服於工人的要求。

ex.en: The capacitance of this part is measured in farads.
ex.zh: 這個零件的電容以法拉為單位。

ex.en: A larger plate area increases the capacitance.
ex.zh: 極板面積越大，電容就越大。

ex.en: The coach castigated the players for their careless mistakes.
ex.zh: 教練嚴厲斥責球員們粗心的失誤。

ex.en: Critics castigated the mayor for ignoring the problem.
ex.zh: 評論者嚴厲批評市長對這個問題置之不理。

ex.en: She is a canny negotiator who always gets a good deal.
ex.zh: 她是個精明的談判者，總是能談到好價格。

ex.en: A canny shopper compares prices before buying.
ex.zh: 精明的消費者購買前會比較價格。

ex.en: Living in that neighborhood has a certain cachet.
ex.zh: 住在那個社區帶有某種名望。

ex.en: The award gave the young actor new cachet.
ex.zh: 這個獎項讓這位年輕演員聲望大增。

ex.en: The earthquake was a cataclysmic event for the region.
ex.zh: 那場地震對該地區是災難性的事件。

ex.en: Scientists warned of cataclysmic changes in the climate.
ex.zh: 科學家警告氣候將出現劇烈的災難性變化。

ex.en: A loud cackle came from the next room.
ex.zh: 隔壁房間傳來一陣響亮的咯咯笑聲。

ex.en: The old woman let out a cackle at the joke.
ex.zh: 老太太聽了笑話發出一聲尖笑。

ex.en: The hens began to cackle when we entered the yard.
ex.zh: 我們走進院子時，母雞開始咯咯叫。

ex.en: She would cackle with joy whenever she won.
ex.zh: 她每次贏了都會開心地咯咯大笑。

ex.en: Writing in a diary can be a catharsis for some people.
ex.zh: 寫日記對有些人來說是一種情緒的宣洩。

ex.en: The sad movie gave the audience a sense of catharsis.
ex.zh: 那部悲傷的電影讓觀眾得到情感的淨化。

ex.en: He tried to cajole his mother into buying a new game.
ex.zh: 他想哄媽媽買新遊戲給他。

ex.en: She cajoled her friends into joining the trip.
ex.zh: 她用好話勸朋友一起去旅行。

ex.en: She practices Chinese calligraphy every weekend.
ex.zh: 她每個週末都練習中國書法。

ex.en: The invitation was written in beautiful calligraphy.
ex.zh: 那張邀請函是用漂亮的書法寫成的。

ex.en: A long causeway connects the island to the mainland.
ex.zh: 一條長長的堤道把小島和本土連接起來。

ex.en: We drove across the causeway at sunset.
ex.zh: 我們在日落時開車越過那條堤道。

ex.en: The priest warned against carnal desires.
ex.zh: 神父警告人們要戒除肉慾。

ex.en: The painting shows a world of carnal pleasures.
ex.zh: 這幅畫呈現了一個肉體享樂的世界。

ex.en: Try to reduce your caloric intake if you want to lose weight.
ex.zh: 如果想減重，試著減少熱量攝取。

ex.en: Nuts are small but very caloric.
ex.zh: 堅果雖小，熱量卻很高。

ex.en: Children cavorted in the waves at the beach.
ex.zh: 孩子們在海灘上的浪花中嬉戲蹦跳。

ex.en: The puppies cavort around the yard all day.
ex.zh: 小狗整天在院子裡跳來跳去。

ex.en: She keeps her tea bags in a small wooden caddy.
ex.zh: 她把茶包放在一個小木盒裡。

ex.en: A shower caddy holds soap and shampoo.
ex.zh: 淋浴置物籃可以放肥皂和洗髮精。

ex.en: The caddy handed him a different club.
ex.zh: 桿弟遞給他另一支球桿。

ex.en: He worked as a caddy at the golf course in summer.
ex.zh: 他夏天在高爾夫球場當桿弟。

ex.en: The caged bird sang by the window.
ex.zh: 籠中的鳥在窗邊唱歌。

ex.en: He felt caged in the small apartment.
ex.zh: 他在那間小公寓裡覺得被困住了。

carpeted.zh: 鋪地毯（carpet 的過去式與過去分詞）

ex.en: They carpeted the whole house before moving in.
ex.zh: 他們搬進去之前把整間房子都鋪上了地毯。

ex.en: The stairs were carpeted in dark red.
ex.zh: 樓梯鋪著深紅色的地毯。

ex.en: I like to snack on salted cashews.
ex.zh: 我喜歡吃鹽味腰果當零食。

ex.en: The curry is creamy because it uses ground cashew.
ex.zh: 這道咖哩因為加了腰果泥而口感綿密。

ex.en: The doctor felt for a pulse in his carotid.
ex.zh: 醫生摸他的頸動脈來測脈搏。

ex.en: The carotid carries blood from the heart to the head.
ex.zh: 頸動脈把血液從心臟送往頭部。

cathartic.zh: 宣洩情緒的；使人釋放的

ex.en: Writing in a diary can be a cathartic experience.
ex.zh: 寫日記可以是一種宣洩情緒的經驗。

ex.en: She found a good cry surprisingly cathartic.
ex.zh: 她發現痛哭一場意外地讓人釋懷。

ex.en: My uncle taught me carpentry in his workshop.
ex.zh: 我叔叔在他的工作室教我木工。

ex.en: Good carpentry takes patience and careful measuring.
ex.zh: 好的木工需要耐心與仔細的測量。

ex.en: The butcher hung the carcase in the cold room.
ex.zh: 屠夫把屠體掛在冷藏室裡。

ex.en: Birds were circling over the carcase of a dead deer.
ex.zh: 鳥兒在一隻死鹿的屍體上空盤旋。

ex.en: The army's capitulation ended the long siege.
ex.zh: 軍隊的投降結束了漫長的圍城。

ex.en: Many saw the deal as a capitulation to the union's demands.
ex.zh: 許多人認為這項協議是向工會要求的屈服。

ex.en: The small boat capsized in the strong wind.
ex.zh: 小船在強風中翻覆了。

ex.en: Don't stand up in the canoe, or it will capsize.
ex.zh: 別在獨木舟上站起來，不然會翻船。

ex.en: Lions are carnivorous animals that hunt in groups.
ex.zh: 獅子是群體狩獵的肉食性動物。

ex.en: The Venus flytrap is a carnivorous plant that catches insects.
ex.zh: 捕蠅草是一種會捕捉昆蟲的食肉植物。

ex.en: The airline canceled our flight because of the typhoon.
ex.zh: 航空公司因為颱風取消了我們的班機。

ex.en: I canceled my gym membership last week.
ex.zh: 我上星期取消了健身房會員資格。

ex.en: She answered with great candour about her mistakes.
ex.zh: 她非常坦率地談到自己的錯誤。

ex.en: I appreciate your candour, even when the news is bad.
ex.zh: 即使消息不好，我也欣賞你的坦率。

ex.en: She answered the questions with great calmness.
ex.zh: 她非常鎮定地回答問題。

ex.en: The calmness of the lake made me feel relaxed.
ex.zh: 湖面的平靜讓我感到放鬆。

ex.en: The scientists carried out several experiments last month.
ex.zh: 科學家們上個月進行了數次實驗。

ex.en: The company will carry out a survey of its customers.
ex.zh: 公司將對顧客進行一次問卷調查。

ex.en: The manager promised to carry out the new safety rules.
ex.zh: 經理承諾會落實新的安全規定。

ex.en: It is hard to carry out a plan without enough money.
ex.zh: 沒有足夠的資金，計畫很難落實。

ex.en: They had to call off the picnic because of the rain.
ex.zh: 因為下雨，他們不得不取消野餐。

ex.en: The coach called off practice when it started to thunder.
ex.zh: 開始打雷時，教練叫停了練習。

ex.en: Please call off your dog; it's scaring the children.
ex.zh: 請把你的狗叫回去，牠嚇到小朋友了。

ex.en: The farmer called off the dogs before they chased the sheep.
ex.zh: 農夫在狗追羊之前把牠們喝止了。

ex.en: Please go ahead. I'll catch up with you in a minute.
ex.zh: 你們先走，我馬上就趕上你們。

ex.en: She studied hard to catch up with the rest of the class.
ex.zh: 她很用功讀書，好趕上班上其他同學的進度。

ex.en: I want to catch up with my old friends this weekend.
ex.zh: 我想這個週末和老朋友敘敘舊。

ex.en: Please calm down and tell me what happened.
ex.zh: 請冷靜下來，告訴我發生了什麼事。

ex.en: It took her a while to calm down after the argument.
ex.zh: 吵完架後，她花了一點時間才平靜下來。

ex.en: Take a deep breath to calm down before the interview.
ex.zh: 面試前先深呼吸讓自己鎮定下來。
